verdict.rationale: Porkbun is an API-driven registrar and DNS platform, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back automated changes (such as DNS record history or reverting a change) is a fair question for it. The pack documents no such capability. Its sandbox keys, dryRun pre-flight checks, idempotency keys and DNS-change webhooks are adjacent safety and notification features: they test or report changes but do not version or revert them.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
